rows:
"We are thankful for this full-day camp as full-time working parents, the energy of the counselors, the safe environment, variety of activities and access to UCSB campus and resources. The staff are very helpful, hard-working and do a great job getting to know the campers and families! We appreciate this program very much and will continue to participate for several
			more years to come!"

"My kids have always loved this camp! They love the variety of activities and the chance to swim and jump off the high dive. The weekly themes are great and the carnival is always a big hit. Also, the camp counselors are great with the kids. The hours of the camp are fantastic as well and are super parent-friendly!"

Camp Olympics
			On your marks, get set, GO! This week, campers will show off their Olympic skills as they learn about different ways of getting active and having fun. Be prepared to run, skip, and leap as we explore different sports.
			Friday Dress Up: Rock your Sportswear!

Superheroes
			My Spidey Senses are tingling! This week campers will embody their favorite superheroes while participating in games and crafts! 
			Friday Dress Up: Dress as your favorite Superhero!

Party in the USA
			Happy Fourth Of July! This week we will join together in to celebrate Independence Day with crafts, games, and more. 
			Friday Dress Up: Red, White, & Blue / Stars!

The Great Outdoors
			"Camper" takes on a whole new meaning this week. Campers will get to explore the great outdoors and see all of the exciting surprises that nature has to offer. Gauchos (ages 11-14) will head over to the Sci Trek laboratory on campus to participate in nature-based science experiments.

Carnival
			Carnival week is one of our favorites and is jam packed with exciting activities. Join us for the fun this week where we bring out our Rock Wall, Bounce Houses, Carnival games and so much more!

Magical World of Camp
			This week, campers will be surrounded by the magic of the Happiest Place on Earth! They will enjoy themed games and crafts about all of their favorite characters. The Gauchos Group will learn about the magic of science at the Sci Trek Lab on campus! 
			Friday Dress Up: Disney Merch!

Young Einsteins 
			Get ready to challenge those brains! This week our campers will dust off their lab coats as they explore the wonders of science and put their imaginations and creations to the test this week with some exciting science experiments! The Gauchos will work in a real-life college lab with our campus partners, Sci Trek! 
			Friday Dress Up: Favorite Science or Scientist!

Camps Got Talent
			For this week, our campers will show off their creative skills and talent as they paint, craft, and create. Campers will end their week with a talent show, with the option to either participate or watch, so be sure to start preparing your act now!

Summer Send Off!
			Campers will end their summer the right way with games, crafts, and an epic music festival. Campers will dance, play, run, and jump their way back into school!

Session 1: Fashion- June 15 to June 199:30-2:00pm for ages 8-12Step into the world of style and creativity in our Fashion Art Camp! Young designers will explore fashion, pattern, and personal style through fun, hands-on building projects. Students will create a large multimedia fashion sketchbook collage filled with textures, colors, and runway-inspired designs, then design and stencil their own bag, complete with a custom charm to show off their unique flair.The creativity continues with a whimsical Paws in Paris canvas, where a charming pup takes a stroll down a café-lined Parisian Street—perfect for practicing painting techniques and storytelling through art. Campers will experiment with mixed media, composition, and design while building confidence in their artistic voice.Ideal for creative kids who love fashion, and imaginative art adventures!




SIGN UP

Session 2: Fairy Forest- June 22 to June 269:30-2:00pm for ages 6-12Step into a magical world of fairies and tiny woodland wonders! In this enchanting art camp, young artists will imagine and create their own Fairy Forest filled with charming fairy homes and miniature gardens. Campers will sculpt clay fairy houses nestled among woodland details, draw fairies with sparkling wings, and design their own fairy homes using markers and paint. Through hands-on projects and lots of creativity, artists will bring their fairy dreams to life while exploring mixed media, drawing, and 3D art.A perfect camp for children who love fantasy, nature, and a touch of magic!




SIGN UP

Session 3: Magic Castle- July 6-July 109:30-2:00pm for ages 6-12Step into the magic of the wizarding world in our Magic Castle Art Camp! This enchanting collection of whimsical projects invites young artists to become storytellers, sparking imagination through hands-on fun and magical design. Campers will create spellbinding artworks inspired by castles, potions, owls, and mysterious landscapes, with plenty of room for personalization in every piece.Students will explore drawing, painting, and mixed media techniques while learning art concepts woven into a magical theme. Each day brings a new creative adventure as campers build their own imaginative worlds and bring their stories to life through art.A perfect camp for young wizards and artists who love fantasy, creativity, and a touch of magic!




SIGN UP

Session 4: Sweet Treats- July 13-July 179:30-2:00pm for ages 6-12Indulge in a delightful collection of sweet-inspired art projects that look almost good enough to eat! In our Sweet Treats Art Camp, young artists will celebrate all things sugary and colorful through fun, hands-on lessons. Campers will craft a three-dimensional cake using a functional box, create a larger-than-life painting of a dessert place setting, and design a donut-themed canvas framed with a fun and funky cardboard border.These imaginative projects offer abundant opportunities for personalization, from frosting colors and sprinkles to playful patterns and unique dessert designs. Students will explore painting, building, and mixed media techniques while learning about color, texture, and composition.Perfect for creative kids with a sweet tooth for art and a love of playful, hands-on projects!




SIGN UP

Session 5: Surf & Turf- July 27-319:30-2:00pm for ages 6-12Summer at its best! In our Surf & Turf Art Camp, young artists will dive into creative fun inspired by the beach, sunshine, and laid-back surf culture. Campers will design vibrant multimedia collage artworks featuring beach scenes, painted surfboards, colorful flip-flops, and even a 3D van to carry their boards to the shore!Students will explore painting, drawing, and mixed media techniques while learning about composition, color, and texture. Each day includes guided instruction, creative play, and plenty of time to personalize projects. By the end of the week, campers will take home a collection of cheerful, summer-inspired artworks they’ll be proud to show off.Perfect for artists who love hands-on creativity and a splash of summer vibes!




SIGN UP

Session 6: Rainforest- August 3-August 79:30-2:00pm for ages 6-12Your artist is invited to join us on a lush rainforest jungle adventure! In this vibrant art camp, students will print, stamp, layer, draw, and collage their way through exciting projects inspired by the wonders of the rainforest. From colorful toucans and stealthy leopards to playful frogs and curious chameleons, campers will love creating and discovering the incredible life hidden in the jungle.Through hands-on lessons, artists will explore mixed media techniques, texture, and composition while learning about rainforest animals and environments. Each project offers plenty of opportunities for personalization and creative expression.Perfect for nature lovers and young artists who are ready to explore, imagine, and create in the heart of the jungle!
